routes.generic: RealTransEvenNode immediate N/2 CFFT must be CS_L1D_CC with exactly one CC and one RC leaf; noSolution required.
routes.recursive: CC1DNode creates two leaf nodes directly, so there is no recursive CC child within a CC. CC nested inside TRTRT/Bluestein is not the immediate real CFFT and is not selected by TryFuseGenericRealPair.
routes.other_rejections: Higher dimensions, batch other than 1, inplace, nonunit strides, user offsets, non-gfx936, embedded real or Bluestein leaves use other paths.
